column1: # Parallel-run bill capture template (PharmaCare Pro pilot — §9 gate evidence)
# Owner fills one row per bill rung up on legacy AND PharmaCare during the
# 2-week parallel-run period. Save as parallel-run-bills.csv (UTF-8). The
# tooling matches each row to PharmaCare's bills.bill_no by paper_invoice_no.
# Lines starting with '#' are ignored by the parser.
#   paper_invoice_no    legacy/manual invoice number; must equal PharmaCare bill_no
#   paper_date_iso      ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the bill
#   paper_total_rupees  grand total in rupees (decimal OK; converted to paise)
#   paper_line_count    number of distinct line items on the paper bill
#   paper_payment_mode  one of: cash | upi | card | credit | wallet | khata
#   paper_notes         free text — anything odd about this bill (optional)
